prompt.en: Who could vote at the time of Confederation?
prompt.fr: Qui pouvait voter à l'époque de la Confédération?

options.fr: Tous les adultes de plus de 21 ans.

options.en: All men and women who paid taxes.
options.fr: Tous les hommes et les femmes qui payaient des impôts.
Seulement les membres de l'assemblée législative.

explanation.en: In 1867 you could vote only if you were a white man, grown up, and owned property. Most democracies drew the line the same way back then. Over the next hundred years, that line kept moving outward.
explanation.fr: En 1867, on ne pouvait voter qu'en étant un homme blanc, adulte et propriétaire. La plupart des démocraties traçaient alors la même limite. Au cours des cent années suivantes, cette limite n'a cessé de reculer.

source.quote: the vote was limited to property-owning adult white males.

verification.evidence: At the time of Confederation, the vote was limited to property-owning adult white males. This was common in most democratic countries at the time. The effort by women to achieve the right to vote is known as the women’s suffrage movement.
